_readme: The CEO's Linear user ids, for the Green Light reply phase (DRE-6138).
scripts/green_light_reply.py sends an epic waiting in Green Light back
for a review once per comment in the CEO's voice. A console answer is
his voice by its signature, and needs nothing here. A comment typed
straight into Linear is his only when its author's Linear user id is in
`ceo_linear_user_ids` below. scripts/epic_growth.py reads the same list
for his answer to a growth question (DRE-6414).
It shipped EMPTY on purpose: an empty list means no Linear comment
counts as his, so nothing fails open and no build agent had to know the
id. The operator declared the one id below on 2026-10-09 (DRE-6498),
after his `re-approve` typed in Linear on DRE-6480 was read as nobody's.
Adding or changing an id is the operator's edit, by hand. A file that
does not hold a list of ids stops the phase rather than reading as empty.
tests/test_green_light_reply.py reads this file as shipped.
